caption: Select an OPML file in the vault.
eval: (async()=>{const demo=app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import']; demo.settings.layout={folder:'OPML sample notes',prefix:'',includeSource:true}; for(const path of ['OPML sample notes/Launch plan.md','OPML sample notes/Reading list.md']){ const file=app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path); if(file && (await app.vault.read(file)).includes('opml_source: OPML Note Import/Projects.opml')) await app.vault.delete(file); }[...app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].dialogs].forEach(d=>d.close()); app.setting.close();app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].pro.signOut();app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].settings.layout={folder:'OPML sample notes',prefix:'',includeSource:true}; app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].openImport('OPML Note Import/Projects.opml'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return 'ok';})()

caption: Preview root note names and nested text.

caption: Pro stores the import layout as a named preset.
eval: (async()=>{[...app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].dialogs].forEach(d=>d.close()); app.setting.close();const p=app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import']; p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('opml-note-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].settings.layout={folder:'OPML sample notes',prefix:'',includeSource:true}; app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].openImport('OPML Note Import/Projects.opml');await app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].savePreset('Project notes',{folder:'OPML sample notes',prefix:'',includeSource:true}); [...p.dialogs].forEach(d=>d.close()); p.openImport('OPML Note Import/Projects.opml'); document.querySelector('.opml-note-import-pro').open=true; document.querySelectorAll('.opml-note-import select')[1].value='Project notes'; document.querySelector('.opml-note-import-pro').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); if(!p.settings.presets.some(x=>x.name==='Project notes')) throw new Error('The preset was not saved.'); const field=document.querySelectorAll('.opml-note-import input[type=text]')[2]; field.value='Project notes'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'ok';})()

caption: Pro compares new outline text with existing note text.
eval: (async()=>{[...app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].dialogs].forEach(d=>d.close()); app.setting.close();const p=app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import']; p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('opml-note-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].settings.layout={folder:'OPML sample notes',prefix:'',includeSource:true}; app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].openImport('OPML Note Import/Projects.opml');await app.plugins.plugins['opml-note-import'].runImport('OPML Note Import/Projects.opml',{folder:'OPML sample notes',prefix:'',includeSource:true}); const f=app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('OPML sample notes/Launch plan.md'); await app.vault.modify(f,(await app.vault.read(f)).replace('Define scope','Review scope')); [...document.querySelectorAll('.opml-note-import button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Preview changes').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.querySelector('.opml-note-import-output').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}); return 'ok';})()
